steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: ...Rahu.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Rahu?

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Rahu!
Rahu snaps back to reality, realizing that Captain is calling her.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Yes! Captain!

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: You were distracted.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Captain, I was just thinking...

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: I don't need to know that. Your mission in the mock battle is to protect the Commander.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Now, due to your negligence, your Commander is dead. You have failed in your duty.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Can an apology bring the Commander back to life?

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Next time, I don't want any more excuses or apologies.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Learn from your mistakes and don't repeat them. That's the meaning of failure.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Understood, Captain.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: With that injury... it will take at least three months before you can return to your duty.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Pay more attention next time. Don't get overheated all the time.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: That one nags...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Do you ever listen?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Indeed, it's thanks to you that we took down that Corruptor that came out of nowhere. Otherwise, Captain would have been the one injured.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Protecting her is my duty.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Duty or not, we all saw how you risked your life to protect her.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: No one is more grateful to you than Captain herself. You didn't see the look on her face. It was the first time I saw her so worried.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Hmm...

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: What's with that look? Don't tell me you think Captain is always so strict with you because she doesn't like you?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Surely you know what kind of person she is, don't you?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Why are you so talkative today?

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Alright, alright, my bad for talking too much.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: Forget about that. Rest up and come back as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Got it...

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: By the way, Rahu, you...

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Rahu?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Yes!

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Don't be so tense, we're not on the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No... I was just...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I was just thinking that this place is really nice...

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Of course it's nice, it's not a dormitory. This is my home. I took out a 25-year mortgage to buy it and I'm still paying it off.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Back when I first joined the FAC, I thought I might die any day and not have to pay off the mortgage. But here I am, still alive.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: I haven't been back here in two years. You two are the only guests I've invited to my home in nearly a decade.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Sit down, we're not in training.
Rahu looks around. In front of the warm fireplace, she, Captain, and Conrad are seated around the dining table and enjoying dinner.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: By the way, Captain, didn't you have something to say?

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: About that...

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Rahu, while you were gone, the G47 squad went through several tough battles.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Jonah and Sheldon... they didn't make it. Conrad was also injured and will be out for a while. This has forced me to consider the future of the squad.
Rahu looks at Conrad, whose leg is in a cast.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: If anything happens to me, you'll take over as the captain.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You will continue to lead the G47 squad. I will protect you.
Varna seems at a loss for words.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Be realistic, Rahu. Every FAC soldier dies on the battlefield. It's only a matter of time. I've never thought I would be an exception.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...I'm not ready yet. You've always been the captain.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Then start getting ready now.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Captaincy aside, even if you're not ready to take my place now, you must always be prepared for when I'm not around.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: When the higher-ups send someone new, make sure to hold back your temper and listen to their commands...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I can't do that!

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You're my Captain, and my loyalty belongs only to you, not anyone else!

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: I knew it was pointless to talk to her about this.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Sigh...
The afterglow of the setting sun filters through the car window, casting a faint but warm glimmer over the passengers.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Why the sudden nervous look?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No... I'm just... thinking.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Thinking about what? It's almost our turn, don't drop the ball on this one.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I was thinking... even if we fight battle after battle, the people around us all leave in the end.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I want to do something... but I can't... I...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm scared that in the end, I'll be the only one left...

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: I'm glad you're sharing these thoughts with me, Rahu.
Looking at this child she personally recruited into the team, Captain gives a familiar smile.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: We all get lost sometimes. We trip and we lose our way... As long as we're alive, we're bound to go through troubles like that.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: To be honest, I've spent half my life at the FAC and I'm still unsure if I've truly overcome it.
Captain places her hand on Rahu's shoulder.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: At times like this, look back and see the people around you.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Look at the people who have dedicated their lives to justice and fairness, and your comrades who you've trusted with your life time and time again... You've still got these lovely folks around you, haven't you?
Captain gazes at Rahu, her eyes firm and gentle.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: You've never been alone, Rahu.
By the time Rahu realizes, a woman has already emerged behind her.
I was wondering when you'd remember.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...I wouldn't forget even if you didn't pull these tricks.
Can't help it, you get angry whenever you remember the past. If you get so mad that you start a fight with Paradeisos, I can't save you.
But now, even if you dream of them, you can sleep peacefully... Everything seems fine now.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Yes.
You've got one now.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Thank you.
I'm the one who should be thanking you... Go for it.
The chaotic scenes fade like melting snow. Memories of the past find their way back to her mind.
The white room, the bright lights, and the smell of disinfectant. The tangible sensations gradually calm Rahu's mind.
Until she turns her head and sees you sitting by the bed.
Memories of the rainstorm come rushing back. Rahu jerks up on the bed, gripping your upper arms tightly.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Where are the HUSH soldiers?! And the notebook?! Where are we? Where did they take you?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Did the news get out? Did they come for you? Where's Conrad?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: My weapon, give me back my weapon, I can't let them do this to you too...

steps.speaker: Medic
steps.content: Calm down! Your M-value is unstable. You've been unconscious for days and you still have a PICC line on you... Lie down immediately!

steps.speaker: Medic
steps.content: You're in the MBCC! The MBCC!
Rahu keeps glaring at you. You know she's not looking away until she gets an answer from you.
You smile and ask the medics to leave, making sure to close the door behind them.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...How many days have I been unconscious? What happened?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: After that battle, I immediately called the 9th Agency and the FAC. Gave them a lot of trouble.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I said the HUSH Unit came to confront me. The evidence at the attack scene was irrefutable. I demanded an explanation and to meet with Hush. I was going to give her a piece of my mind, or I wouldn't be able to get over this.
You watch her as you speak. Rahu is breaking out in a cold sweat and her tight knuckles around your arms are turning white. Even the back of her clothes is soaking wet.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: So... what did they say?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: What else could they have said? I got an earful from my boss. They said Paradeisos had claimed that those soldiers were mere system errors and they were going to look into that.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The higher-ups were playing it down, basically telling me: "We know you're right but let's call it a day."

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: But they... surely that's not the end of the story...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Of course that's not the end.

choices.text: Of course that's not the end.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I made a big fuss and took the opportunity to bargain. I even threw in a list of materials the Supply Office had to restock. You know me, my honesty is my biggest flaw.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The two departments sent everything over right away. They were reluctant, but they didn't miss a single item. It was a great harvest for the Bureau. Faye couldn't stop grinning.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Is that enough for you?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Yes, I was very satisfied and came back with a big smile.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I can't understand why...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Aren't you afraid of being targeted?
She lowers her head as she speaks, a lot less prickly than she was a few days ago. Her frustration is on display.
It feels bratty to tease a genuine person like her. You put away your joking expression and put on a serious tone.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Don't overthink it. I've always been their target.

choices.text: Don't overthink it. I've always been their target.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I don't know how you managed to come so far while shouldering everything alone, but... my journey hasn't been easy either. I've endured a lot.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: They put me here only to keep an eye on me. Whatever I do, Paradeisos won't feel at ease.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: So, instead of behaving and risking their suspicion, I choose to meet their expectations.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: After all, if I make them uneasy by throwing tantrums from time to time, it'll be more convincing to play dumb afterward.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I guarantee you, they prefer a straightforward and easily satisfied troublemaker like me.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Are you sure?
You nod.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Conrad is doing a lot better too.

choices.text: Conrad is doing a lot better too.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: With help of the FAC, we've arranged a convalescent site for him outside of DisCity and informed Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Conrad will receive protection as a victim of HUSH's system errors and an FAC hero. All of this is on public record. If we're lucky, he might become a Sinner. At that time, we can formally transfer him back.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If you wish, you can visit him too. We'll just say you're escorting the Chief of Minos.
There's another moment of silence.
Then, surprisingly, she manages a small smile, her gaze a lot softer now.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'll never understand people like you and your roundabout ways.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: My roundabout ways won't work if I'm on my own. It's all thanks to my previous connections.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: In any case, things are not as bad for me as you think. Even I can stand up for myself.

steps.speaker: ...This look on her always makes you hesitate. But... you know you have to ask.
steps.content: Yes. My intuition tells me that no one should ever mess with you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I meant it as a compliment.
Oh, should I be flattered?
She opens her mouth to say something, but finally just shakes her head with a smile.
You look at her and begin slowly.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: By the way, there's one more thing on my list of required items. This one is a little complicated, and Paradeisos is not so generous this time.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What is that?
The light on her face quickly fades away.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...What did they say?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Nothing. Just that the transfer order was a system error, and that Paradeisos needs you. They want you back.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Is that so...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Hmm... I see.
Her voice changes, as if she's made some kind of decision. It makes you feel uneasy.
Her determination always reminds you of someone venturing alone into darkness. That's not what you intended.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I won't let them have their way. You're a Sinner shackled by me who resisted the HUSH soldiers under my control. They should know better.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Even if it means making some concessions, I'll keep you. They could always use some help from me.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Did you seriously think I'd let you go so easily? Took me enough effort to finally reel in a Paradeisian.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Are you saying that you expect me to repay you for doing all this?
Her tone changes, and the confusion in her pale silver eyes is gone. As you're observing her, she's also scrutinizing you.
Her gaze softens a little at your dumbfounded face.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I can tell from your face that you don't mean that. You're smarter than that, Chief.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: It seems I'm always caught in some trouble whenever you see me. How embarrassing.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What happened with Conrad was unexpected. I admit I made a blunder. I've always felt like I owed him. So I almost fell into HUSH's trap and did something stupid.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Now that you're watching over him, I can finally rest easy.
You jerk up and grab her arm.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What do you mean by that?

choices.text: What do you mean by that?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I didn't do all this just so you can be gone without worries. Don't do anything stupid.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I understand. Don't worry. I haven't been faring too badly in Paradeisos, otherwise I would have died there four days ago.
She looks at you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I assume you're desperate for information about Paradeisos now. That's why you're so interested in a nobody like me.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I genuinely wish the best for you.

choices.text: I genuinely wish the best for you.

steps.content: Rahu smiles. She's been smiling more lately.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm glad you need this. I want to repay you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: These days, I've taken on many tasks from Paradeisos. I've been taking note of the things I see.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Not all Paradeisians are enemies, or should I say... If you consider them all as your enemies, you'll end up in a dead end.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Although I can't yet tell who can be trusted, I know how to deal with certain individuals and who can help me.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: When the day comes that you need it, they might just be able to lend you a hand.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You're more reliable than I thought.

choices.text: You're more reliable than I thought.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: After all, I've been through a lot.
She stays quiet for a moment, as if contemplating something. Lowering her gaze, slowly, she begins to speak in a soft voice you've never heard before.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: There have been times when I've gained more than I've lost... There were people who helped me, pulling me back from the brink of hell time and time again.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The first person taught me to seek the light.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The second person walked with me through darkness.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: And you... you showed me something other than pitch-black vengeance.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I was once stripped of everything. You reminded me that there's more... I don't have to give up anything to move forward. I still have many important things worth protecting.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Thank you for helping me break free from the curse. So...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Let me return to Paradeisos, ${PlayerName}.
She lifts her head. Sunlight filters through the veil and illuminates the sickroom, clearing away all the shadows on her face.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: That's the path that suits me most.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I've received a lot of help from you. This time, I'll return the favor.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...What do you mean by let you return to Paradeisos? Don't tell me you expect me to give you that terrible order.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm not giving you that order. You'd be better off sneaking back on your own.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Haha... You've ordered me to do way worse things. What difference will one more make?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Then consider it a blessing.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: We're living in a time when we must see clearly ahead if we want to keep moving. I'll find my way.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: From now on, I'll be a nail you've hammered in Paradeisos. I may be silent for a long time, but someday, you'll hear my echo.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Before that, give me your blessing. I want to protect all of you in my own way.
In a neat uniform and with her shield polished shiny, she comes to your desk.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I should go now, Commander.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'll leave your MBCC position open. You can come back anytime.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'll take care of Conrad for you... Don't forget you're not alone. Here, at the MBCC... the doors are always open for you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Understood. And remember, no matter how difficult your path may be, there's always someone guarding you in the shadows.
She gives you her last soft smile, resumes her warrior posture, and turns to leave.
You call out to her. After a long pause, you speak.
She smiles and gives you a standard FAC salute.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Best of luck to you too, ${PlayerName}.
Finishing her gesture, Rahu puts on her mask and confidently sets out on her new journey.
